sub_sections.title: Maw
sub_sections.description_text:
Fitting that we end this guide where we start the game....As you progress through will come to the very room that you started the game in

[previewicon=18258523;sizeOriginal,inline;10.1.jpg][/previewicon]

Go up the ladder and where you see the first NPC die from before, the same room is where the final terminal will be (glowing red on the wall)

[previewicon=18258522;sizeOriginal,inline;10.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Thank you!
sub_sections.description_text: Thank you for looking at my guide, and if you need any help or are unclear about any of the above please let me know in the comments...and I would definitely appreciate leaving me a nice rating :)

sub_sections.title: Keyes
sub_sections.description_text:
Back on the same ship as before, the terminal is also in the same room as before...this time underneath the raised platform

[previewicon=18258507;sizeOriginal,inline;9.1.jpg][/previewicon]

[previewicon=18258510;sizeOriginal,inline;9.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Two Betrayals
sub_sections.description_text:
Very simple, at the very start of the level, turn around and the terminal will be behind you

[previewicon=18258498;sizeOriginal,inline;8.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Library
sub_sections.description_text:
Once again, this mission will consists of several elevators going up one floor at a time...once you reach the third floor and enter the large open room, make your way around towards the other side of the gap to find the terminal

[previewicon=18258485;sizeOriginal,inline;7.1.jpg][/previewicon]

[previewicon=18258486;sizeOriginal,inline;7.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: 343 Guilty Spark
sub_sections.description_text:
As you go through this level you will come across several elevators...The first two elevators will go down, but the third elevator you find will go up instead.  Right as soon as it starts going up jump off onto this platform to get the terminal

[previewicon=18258475;sizeOriginal,inline;6.1.jpg][/previewicon]

[previewicon=18258476;sizeOriginal,inline;6.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Assault on the Control Room
sub_sections.description_text:
As you progress through, you will come across a large structure that seems to have a diagonal pillar that runs all the way through the center

[previewicon=18258453;sizeOriginal,inline;5.1.jpg][/previewicon]

Underneath that pillar on the ground is the terminal

[previewicon=18258454;sizeOriginal,inline;5.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Silent Cartographer
sub_sections.description_text:
At the structure where you fight the two hunters, the terminal will be attached to the side

[previewicon=18258450;sizeOriginal,inline;4.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Truth and Reconciliation
sub_sections.description_text:
As you progress you will come to a room that has a raised balcony in the middle, walk up it and the terminal will be in the back middle

[previewicon=18258410;sizeOriginal,inline;3.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Halo
sub_sections.description_text:
When you get into the cave (No, its not a natural formation *gasp*) you will get to a spot where it kind of drops you onto a ramp leading to a gap you need to jump

[previewicon=18258400;sizeOriginal,inline;2.1.jpg][/previewicon]

if you fall into the gap or go around down the ramp you will find the terminal there

[previewicon=18258401;sizeOriginal,inline;2.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: Pillar of Autumn
sub_sections.description_text:
When you get to the bridge where you talk to Captain Keyes, one of the computer spots will be empty and glowing red

[previewicon=18258391;sizeOriginal,inline;1.jpg][/previewicon]
